Package org.dreambot.api.input.event.impl.mouse

Class MouseEventGenerator

  • java.lang.Object
    • org.dreambot.api.input.event.impl.mouse.MouseEventGenerator
  • public class MouseEventGenerator
extends java.lang.Object
    Utility class to generate a MouseEvent for the given parameters. Automatically generates necessary modifiers Generally speaking should not be used by scripters but is available if they want to make custom implementations of events.
